pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and tessellated dark regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. The geometry transitions from large, irregular polygons on the mid-flank to smaller, more rounded, sub-circular clusters on the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological web of predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly towards the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dark brown mane. The jagged edge is consistent and continuous from the upper neck through the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized cluster of small, white de-pigmented specks and minor textural disruption present on the mid-flank, posterior to the shoulder.
